textual.potential_relevance: A promised recurring return is directly linked to opening and funding a broker account, creating a reward-and-payment relationship that may require later contextual assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that any return was paid, that funds were lost, or that the broker relationship, account, or stated safety measures were verified.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes Mirror Trading International as a way to earn weekly trading income while requiring participants to fund an account and recruit others who make deposits. It emphasizes assurances such as 100% security and a transparent platform, then presents a binary compensation plan with two required recruits and a 10% bonus on their deposited funds. The closing instruction to call, sign up, and start earning makes this an active solicitation rather than neutral financial commentary.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the advertised earning mechanism explicitly depends on a binary structure with one person on each side, minimum deposits by those recruits, weaker-leg volume, and direct referral commissions. S03 is secondary because the same promotion links participation and funded trading accounts to recurring weekly profit distributions.
